ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Culturally shared views of the self have been suggested to have profound influences on basic attention processes. In Western cultures, individuals are encouraged to discover their internal attributes such as desires and personal goals, and therefore they may be expected to focus their attention on events that are relevant to such desires and goals. As a result, their attention may become focused. This cognitive style, which is anchored in a focal object in lieu of its context, has been called analytic. In contrast, in Eastern cultures individuals are more attuned to various aspects of ever-important social relations and, as a consequence, they may be expected to attend more broadly to a focal object as well as to its surrounding context, drawing inferences about the relationship between the object and its context. This mode of cognition has been called holistic. These predictions have been borne out. For example, when presented with an animated vignette of an underwater scene and subsequently asked to remember what they saw, European Americans were more likely to recall focal objects, whereas Japanese were more likely to refer to contextual information as well as relationships between the focal objects.

In contrast, in Eastern cultures individuals are more attuned to various aspects of ever-important social relations and, as a consequence, they may be expected to attend more broadly to a focal object as well as to its surrounding context, drawing inferences about the relationship between the object and its context. This mode of cognition has been called holistic. These predictions have been borne out. For example, when presented with an animated vignette of an underwater scene and subsequently asked to remember what they saw, European Americans were more likely to recall focal objects, whereas Japanese were more likely to refer to contextual information as well as relationships between the focal objects.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ focusing → focused: 'their attention may become focusing'이면 become 뒤에 현재분사가 와서 비문. 원문은 과거분사/형용사 focused가 올바름. ← 정답
det.analysis:
✅ ① suggested: 'have been suggested to have'에서 수동태 과거분사로 올바름
✅ ② to discover: 'are encouraged to discover'에서 to부정사로 올바름
❌ ③ focusing → focused: 'their attention may become focusing'에서 become은 2형식 동사로 보어 자리에 형용사 focused가 와야 함. focusing(현재분사/동명사)은 부적절 ← 정답
✅ ④ called: 'has been called analytic'에서 수동태 과거분사로 올바름
det.tip: become은 2형식 동사로 뒤에 형용사 보어가 옵니다. focused는 '집중된'이라는 형용사이고, focusing은 동명사/현재분사입니다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① what → which: 'This cognitive style, what is anchored in a focal object'이면 관계대명사절에 선행사(This cognitive style)가 있으므로 what은 부적절. 원문은 which(계속적 용법)가 올바름. ← 정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ therefore → whereas: 'European Americans were more likely to recall focal objects, therefore Japanese were more likely to refer to contextual information'이면 인과관계 접속부사인데 문맥상 대조관계임. 원문은 접속사 whereas(~인 반면에)가 올바름. ← 정답
det.analysis:
✅ ① relevant: 'events that are relevant to such desires'에서 형용사로 올바름
✅ ② broadly: 'attend more broadly to a focal object'에서 부사가 동사 attend를 수식하여 올바름
✅ ③ presented: 'when presented with an animated vignette'에서 분사구문(수동)으로 올바름
❌ ④ therefore → whereas: 미국인은 초점 대상을 회상하고 일본인은 맥락 정보를 언급한다는 대조 관계를 표현해야 함. therefore(따라서)는 인과 접속부사로 부적절. whereas(~인 반면에)가 올바름 ← 정답
det.tip: whereas는 대조를 나타내는 접속사로, 두 절의 상반되는 내용을 연결합니다. therefore는 인과관계를 나타냅니다.

questions.passage: Culturally shared views of the self have been suggested to have profound influences on basic attention processes. In Western cultures, individuals are encouraged to discover their internal attributes such as desires and personal goals, and therefore they may be expected to focus their attention on events that are relevant to such desires and goals. As a result, their attention may become focused. This cognitive style, which is anchored in a focal object in lieu of its context, has been called ③<u>analytic</u>. In contrast, in Eastern cultures individuals are more attuned to various aspects of ever-important social relations and, as a consequence, they may be expected to attend more broadly to a focal object as well as to its surrounding context, drawing ④<u>inferences</u> about the relationship between the object and its context. This mode of cognition has been called holistic. These predictions have been borne out. For example, when presented with an animated vignette of an underwater scene and subsequently asked to remember what they saw, European Americans were more likely to ①<u>recall</u> focal objects, whereas Japanese were more likely to refer to ②<u>irrelevant</u> information as well as relationships between the focal objects.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② irrelevant → contextual: '일본인은 무관한(irrelevant) 정보를 언급할 가능성이 높았다'는 문맥과 맞지 않음. 원문은 contextual(맥락적) 정보가 올바름. ← 정답
det.analysis:
✅ ④ analytic: '이 인지 양식은 분석적(analytic)이라 불려 왔다'는 서양 문화의 초점 중심 사고를 설명하는 맥락에 적절
✅ ① inferences: '대상과 맥락 사이의 관계에 대한 추론(inferences)을 도출하면서'는 동양의 전체론적 인지를 설명하는 맥락에 적절
✅ ③ recall: '유럽계 미국인은 초점 대상을 회상(recall)할 가능성이 높았다'는 실험 결과를 설명하는 맥락에 적절
❌ ② irrelevant → contextual: 일본인이 '무관한' 정보를 언급했다는 것은 동양의 전체론적 인지 설명과 정반대. 원문은 contextual(맥락적) 정보 ← 정답
det.tip: contextual은 '맥락적인', irrelevant는 '무관한'으로 정반대 의미입니다. 동양 문화의 전체론적 인지는 맥락 정보에 주의를 기울이는 것입니다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 초점 대상에 고정되고 맥락을 무시하는 인지 양식은 분석적(analytic)이라 불려 왔다.
det.analysis:

❌ ③ creative(창의적인): 본문에서 창의성은 전혀 논의되지 않음
❌ ④ emotional(감정적인): 본문은 주의 과정과 인지 양식에 대한 글. 감정은 무관

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 유럽계 미국인은 초점 대상(focal objects)을 회상할 가능성이 높았다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ focal objects(초점 대상): 유럽계 미국인(서양)이 분석적 인지 양식을 보여 초점 대상을 회상하고, 일본인(동양)은 맥락 정보를 언급했다는 실험 결과의 핵심 ← 정답
❌ ② social relations(사회적 관계): 동양 문화의 특성 설명에 사용된 어구. 미국인의 실험 결과와 맞지 않음
❌ ③ personal goals(개인적 목표): 서양 문화 설명의 일부이지만, 수중 장면 실험에서 회상한 것은 목표가 아니라 대상
❌ ① profound influences(깊은 영향): 도입부의 일반론이지, 실험 결과에서 회상한 것이 아님
det.tip: 서양의 분석적 사고 → 초점 대상(focal objects) 회상. 동양의 전체론적 사고 → 맥락 정보(contextual information) 언급. 이 대조가 핵심입니다.

det.korean: 본문: 'Japanese were more likely to refer to contextual information as well as relationships between the focal objects.' — 일본인은 맥락 정보와 관계를 언급했지, 초점 대상만 기억한 것이 아님.

questions.passage: Culturally shared views of the self have been suggested to have profound influences on basic attention processes. In Western cultures, individuals are encouraged to discover their internal attributes such as desires and personal goals, and therefore they may be expected to focus their attention on events that are relevant to such desires and goals. As a result, their attention may become focused. This cognitive style, which is anchored in a focal object in lieu of its context, has been called analytic. In contrast, in Eastern cultures individuals are more attuned to various aspects of ever-important social relations and, as a consequence, they may be expected to attend more broadly __________, drawing inferences about the relationship between the object and its context. This mode of cognition has been called holistic. These predictions have been borne out. For example, when presented with an animated vignette of an underwater scene and subsequently asked to remember what they saw, European Americans were more likely to recall focal objects, whereas Japanese were more likely to refer to contextual information as well as relationships between the focal objects.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 [조건]에 맞게 영작하시오. (11단어) (영어로)
"초점 대상뿐만 아니라 그것의 주변 맥락에도"
[조건] (1) a, as, as, context, focal, its, object, surrounding, to, to, well를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 11단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 초점 대상뿐만 아니라 그것의 주변 맥락에도.
det.analysis: 원문: 'attend more broadly to a focal object as well as to its surrounding context.' to(1) a(2) focal(3) object(4) as(5) well(6) as(7) to(8) its(9) surrounding(10) context(11) = 11단어 조건 충족. 모든 제시 단어(a, as, as, context, focal, its, object, surrounding, to, to, well) 사용.
det.tip: 'as well as'는 '~뿐만 아니라'라는 뜻입니다. 'a focal object as well as its surrounding context'는 초점 대상과 주변 맥락 모두를 나타냅니다.
